_documentation.purpose: Task config for the new single-turn Migration Delivery Sequencing PM task. Consumes the supplied book of work + Migration Discovery Context + Target State Captured Decisions and produces a recommended initiative ordering (sequence / parallelisableWith / blockedBy / rationale). The sequencing answer is persisted as a captured decision via Spec 2's POST endpoint with decision_code='delivery.sequencing'.
_documentation.contextNeeds: migration-discovery-context (so the LLM can reason about cross-initiative dependencies), target-state-decisions-context (the architect's captured technology decisions, cited in initiative rationale).
_documentation.responseSchema: MigrationDeliverySequencingResponse three-variant structured response (Sequenced / InsufficientContext / Failed) validated by gateway/src/services/migrationDeliverySequencingResponseValidator.ts (hand-rolled per Q11; mirrors specGenerationResponseValidator.ts pattern).
_documentation.promptRules: Must cite decision codes in `rationale`; must reference initiative IDs only from the supplied book of work; mandatory functional-equivalence clause; single-turn; no follow-up questions.
_documentation.designPointRefs: Q3 static availableFrom mirroring existing two PM tasks (runtime gating in handler); Q10 distinguish no-target vs no-decisions via recommendedNextAction text; Q11 hand-rolled validator; Q12 bookOfWorkId is a required handler input (no new AMS endpoint); Q13 validator hard fails + warning-only cycle detection; Q14 prompt wording finalised at write-spec time; Q15 createdByTask + null thread/turn ref; Q17 reuse existing fetchLatestCapturedDecisions + fetchActiveTargetArchitectureId.

description: Single-turn PM task that produces a recommended initiative ordering for the supplied book of work, citing the captured technology decisions. Output is persisted as a captured decision (decision_code='delivery.sequencing', scope_kind='architecture') via the Spec 2 data plane so re-runs supersede the prior answer through the normal supersession path. Runtime gating in the handler returns status='insufficient_context' when no active target architecture exists or when no decisions have been captured yet.

responseFormat.description: Three structured-response variants validated by assertMigrationDeliverySequencingResponse (gateway/src/services/migrationDeliverySequencingResponseValidator.ts). Branch is keyed on the top-level `status` field.

artifacts.description: Sequencing answer persisted as a captured decision via Spec 2's POST endpoint (decision_code='delivery.sequencing', scope_kind='architecture', createdByTask='product-manager--migration-delivery-sequencing', conversationThreadId=null, conversationTurnRef=null, answerValue=JSON-stringified initiativeOrder). Supersession via Spec 2's data plane on re-run.
